the fed's own bio card (promotions/wwo/archive/bio-card-don-cameron.html)
tenures.note: Undated on the card itself; 2001 is the Wayback capture year, a roster-snapshot date, not an attested tenure span.

tenures.source: The fed's own titles page (promotions/nccw-1998/archive/nccw-titles-1999.html). Won the World Heavyweight Championship three times (23 May 1998, "Ignition" PPV; 29 August 1998, "FanFest '98" PPV; and a third, undated reign per a fellow participant's own 2003 reminiscence, already held). Also co-held the World Tag Team Championship with "GQ" Geoffrey Quartz from 26 August 1998, winning a tournament forced after New Austrian Powers discarded the belts. The fed's own Dec 1998 recruitment/FAQ post (already held) names him alongside "StarFox" Curt Crane and "Bullet" Ricky Revolution as one of NCCW's recognizable names, "known in the EWA and the NWWF beforehand," and the fed's own Family Tree page separately lists him as an NWWF alumnus.
